label: demo-food-access-v1
notes: Bundled demo codebook. Every exemplar is a VERBATIM participant turn from the bundled transcripts, so the deductive run can resolve gold views by text_sha256. In a real project this codebook is built from gold exemplars and human promotion.

codes.name: Transportation barriers
codes.definition: Participant describes travel, vehicle access, or transit problems that shape how the household obtains food.
codes.inclusion: Bus or car dependency, service cuts, long travel distances, skipping trips when transport fails.
codes.exclusion: General store distance complaints with no travel or vehicle component.
exemplars: I take the number 12 bus, or I ask my sister when the bus cuts service. There is no full grocery store left in the neighborhood, so it is a forty minute trip each way.
My wife and I share a car with her mother, so grocery runs happen on Saturdays only. If the car is unavailable we skip it, and that is when the freezer gets emptied.

codes.name: Cost and budget pressure
codes.definition: Participant describes food prices, income limits, or budget trade-offs that change what the household eats.
codes.inclusion: Share of income spent on food, paycheck timing, utilities-vs-food trade-offs, discount or bulk strategies driven by price.
codes.exclusion: Program eligibility complaints that are not about the household budget itself.
exemplars: They eat almost a third of it. I work part time, so the week before payday we are stretching rice and beans and whatever is on sale.
On a fixed disability check every dollar is planned. When utilities spike in summer, the food line shrinks first. The food pantry on Grand Avenue covers the gap maybe twice a month.

codes.name: Fresh food demand
codes.definition: Participant expresses unmet demand for fresh produce, fish, or other perishable foods, or names growing/food-producing spaces they want to use.
codes.inclusion: Wishes for vegetables, fruit, fish, or greens; community gardens; markets that closed; perishables they cannot keep stocked.
codes.exclusion: Price-only complaints about produce with no demand or access component.
exemplars: Fresh vegetables, honestly. There is a community garden on 5th that lets neighbors grow beds, and I would join in a heartbeat if the evening hours worked with my shift.
Fresh fish and greens. There used to be a market on 9th before it closed. Now the closest thing is a gas station.
